name: Mace Group
description: UK construction and consultancy group whose markets include Technology and Manufacturing (covering data centres); split in March 2026 into Mace Consult (infrastructure and capital-programme consultancy) and Mace Construct (construction), with international delivery including Expo 2030 Riyadh.

sources.note: Mace homepage: construction and consultancy, markets incl. Technology and Manufacturing, March 2026 business split, read 2026-11-12
